scope: Six official Paddle formula ONNX exports; this is an evidence index, not a new benchmark run.

backendStatus.boundary: These include string-level metrics plus a locked MathJax SVG renderability/raster-shape diagnostic. They are not mathematical-semantic equivalence, full-TeX portability, a held-out guarantee, or a release-quality pass. Training overlap is unknown.

All six exact exports remain blocked in isolated processes: five FormulaNet graphs fail Loop-18 canonical-input/import validation and UniMERNet aborts the model-reader process. No formula quality result was produced.

All six exact formula exports were compared with ORT CPU on bounded realFormula inputs. Plus-S/M/S have three-sample in-process evidence; Plus-L/L/UniMERNet are currently accepted only as one sample per fresh process because repeated autoregressive runs in one process can contaminate CUDA Int64 output. The lifecycle option probe did not eliminate the contamination. The dedicated FormulaNet-L single-session probe reproduced the corruption after reusing one CPU Session and one CUDA Session for three samples: the first row was valid, while the next two returned 1,024 out-of-range Int64 values and no EOS. The report records raw-output comparability, token-ID equality and decoder error classification. This is execution/parity evidence only: it is not a 121-sample quality score, mathematical-semantic equivalence, controlled performance benchmark or cross-device portability result.

The six exact exports were attempted at both batch=1 and dynamic batch=2 on OpenCV 5.0.0 CPU. Five batch=1 imports fail at ConstantOfShape zero-dimension specialization and UniMERNet fails during importer allocation; the batch=2 attempts also fail with DS-OCV-8002. No formula decoder or quality result was produced. This is limited to the exact artifacts/runtime and does not imply another OpenCV build or backend failure.

All six exact formula ONNX exports have now had independent TensorRT 11 Batch=1 and TensorRT 10.11 API-10 dynamic Batch=2 builder attempts on the recorded host. Five FormulaNet graphs fail the Loop BitwiseAnd importer check; UniMERNet fails the If ConcatFromSequence importer check. No Engine, Decoder, formula quality or performance result exists. These causes are distinct and limited to the exact ONNX files and recorded runtime/API lines; they are not universal TensorRT-version claims.

knownQualityRisks.issue: One realFormula sample did not emit EOS before the 1,024-step export ceiling; the official Paddle IR and ONNX Loop share that ceiling and extending it exceeds the learned positional table.
High exact-match/CER on realFormula means the single-image smoke examples must not be used as accuracy claims; canonicalization and model/data suitability remain open.

nextGates: Add mathematical-semantic equivalence and an independent renderer check beyond the current MathJax SVG/raster diagnostic.
Diagnose FormulaNet-L non-EOS behavior without changing the public decoder to silently truncate or synthesize EOS.

For TensorRT, prototype a maintained fixed-state encoder/decoder export or plugin path; only after it creates engines should token parity, real-formula quality and controlled performance be evaluated.
For OpenVINO, pursue a new supported export or importer/runtime change before repeating isolated compatibility experiments.
